job.title: Java Software Developer in Bremen - Bruker Corporation

tailoring.headline: Java Software Developer & SAP Commerce (Hybris) Expert | 5+ Years E-Commerce Backend Experience
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in technical design, requirement analysis, and production support within agile, international teams. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and AI-assisted development. Holds SAP Commerce Cloud certification and a valid German work permit.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Java Software Developer – Bruker Corporation
cover_en.hook: I am excited to contribute to Bruker’s cutting-edge scientific solutions. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce (Hybris) development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep Java expertise and proven success in building robust e-commerce platforms that power global businesses.

bullets.label: Technical Design
bullets.text: Designed and implemented scalable backend components on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java, Spring and OCC REST APIs, delivering clean technical designs aligned with business goals.

bullets.label: Requirement Analysis
bullets.text: Collaborated with international stakeholders to analyse customer requirements, translate them into detailed user stories and functional specifications, and ensure seamless delivery.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM/ERP/MDM data pipelines, enabling reliable headless commerce and third-party consumption.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Engineered end-to-end data flows using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, synchronising product catalogs across multiple systems and improving data consistency.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to Bruker.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Java Software Developer – Bruker Corporation
cover_de.hook: Mit großer Begeisterung bewerbe ich mich für die Position bei Bruker. In den letzten fünf Jahren habe ich als SAP Commerce (Hybris) Entwickler bei Rockwell Automation und Shell komplexe Java-Lösungen realisiert, die weltweit im E-Commerce eingesetzt werden.

bullets.label: Technisches Design
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte skalierbare Backend-Komponenten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java, Spring und OCC-REST-APIs, stets im Einklang mit den fachlichen Vorgaben.

bullets.label: Anforderungsanalyse
bullets.text: Analysierte Kundenanforderungen gemeinsam mit internationalen Stakeholdern, erstellte detaillierte User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und stellte die termingerechte Umsetzung sicher.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Entwickelte und veröffentlichte OCC-REST-Web-Services und integrierte PIM/ERP/MDM-Datenpipelines, um eine zuverlässige Headless-Commerce-Architektur zu ermöglichen.

bullets.label: Integration & Datenpipelines
bullets.text: Konzipierte und realisierte End-to-End-Datenflüsse mit Profisee, DataHub und Hotfolders, wodurch Produktkataloge über mehrere Systeme hinweg konsistent synchronisiert wurden.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zu Bruker zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: Bruker’s reputation for pioneering precision instruments that advance scientific research aligns with my passion for delivering high-quality, reliable software. I am impressed by Bruker’s commitment to innovation and global impact, and I want to apply my SAP Commerce and Java expertise to support the development of robust digital solutions that empower researchers worldwide.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Bruker to combine my SAP Commerce expertise with a company that drives scientific innovation and delivers high-impact digital solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) developer with 5+ years of Java experience. I’m eager to bring my expertise to Bruker’s Java Software Developer role. Could we discuss how I can contribute?
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Java Software Developer – Bruker Corporation
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Java Software Developer position at Bruker. With over five years of SAP Commerce (Hybris) development experience and a strong Java background, I am confident I can add immediate value. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.

Best regards,
